physical_subject: What path follows a straight-moving puller through a fixed thread?
relationship: A trailing point constrained to move along a fixed-length tangent toward a straight-moving puller traces a tractrix and approaches the line asymptotically.
operation: A straight-moving tractor pulls an ideal trailing point, preserving tangent length; a shorter thread gives a scaled comparison.
closest_prior: linked/02-pursuit: four equal-speed chasers; old catenary: hanging chain equilibrium
substantive_difference: One tractor moves along a line while a fixed-length tangent constrains a follower; the speed of the follower is not assumed equal to the tractor and no hanging-chain balance is taught.
